description: This Java class file 'ZonesLoader.java' is responsible for loading zone data from a JSON resource file, parsing the data, creating zone and description objects, and returning a map of zones. It uses services for languages and countries, reads JSON input, and constructs domain objects related to geographical zones.

classes.name: ZonesLoader
classes.description: A Spring-managed component class that loads geographical zone data from JSON files and constructs domain objects.

methods.name: loadZones
methods.description: Loads zones from a JSON resource file, parsing and constructing zone and description objects, and returning a map of zones keyed by zone code.
